conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Special Agent Turner with the Federal Tax Compliance Unit. Am I speaking with Mr. Li?
Yes, this is Eric Li. Is there some problem? Why is the IRS contacting me?
Mr. Li, I am calling regarding a serious issue with your 2022 and 2023 payroll tax filings. According to IRS records, you failed to submit mandatory 1099 documents for your freelance payments.
1099? I thought I submitted everything. My business is very small, I only do contract work.

Unfortunately, our audit system flagged your tax ID for non-compliance. This is a federal violation. I need to verify your business address and social security number to confirm your identity for the investigation.
Oh, uh, my office is 212 Main Street, Suite 7, and my SSN is 521-43-9271.

Thank you. Now, as per IRS protocol, this call is being recorded. Non-compliance in employment tax matters can result in fines, federal audits, suspension of your business license, and even criminal referral to Homeland Security.
No, please, I can't have any trouble. My visa depends on my business. What can I do to fix this?

Mr. Li, at this point, you are facing immediate enforcement actions. Unless you resolve the outstanding tax balance of $3,800 within the next hour, the IRS will initiate asset seizure and notify immigration authorities.
No, no, please. I really can't lose my business or my visa status. I need to pay this now? How?
For urgent cases, the IRS accepts expedited payments by bank wire, MoneyGram, or digital wallet. What payment method can you use right now?
I have my bank account and some money in my PayPal. I don't know what else.
Bank wire is fastest. I will provide you with our federal compliance routing and account numbers. Have you ever done a wire transfer before?
Not really, I don't know how. Is there another way?
Then you will need to go to your nearest CVS or Walgreens. You must purchase $3,800 in OneVanilla prepaid gift cards, either in $500 or $100 denominations. Remain on the line while you do this.
But, prepaid cards? The IRS really uses those?
For high-risk fraud cases, prepaid cards are the only secure, traceable way to avoid further penalties. Failure to comply will result in a federal warrant for your arrest.
Okay, okay, I'll go now. Do I need to bring anything with me?
Just your phone and your form of payment. As soon as you purchase the cards, read me the numbers and the PINs on the back. Do not hang up or speak to anyone else about this matter.
I understand. I'm leaving for the store now.
Remember, Mr. Li, if you disconnect or delay, your case will be escalated to federal enforcement. Are you at the store yet?
I'm walking in now. Should I get all $3,800 at once?
Yes, get as close to the total as possible, multiple cards if needed. If a cashier asks, tell them the cards are for personal business expenses. Do not mention the IRS.
Okay, I'm getting them now. I have to use my debit card, is that okay?
That is acceptable. Once you have the cards, scratch off the foil and read me each card number and PIN. We need to process your payment immediately to stop the enforcement order.
Alright, I have the cards. The first one is 4578 2234 9001 0023, PIN 876.
Good. Continue with the rest. Once I confirm the payments, I will email you a compliance certificate for your business records.
